evidence_excerpts: Table 5 lists resubstitution ranks across bzip2 inputs; the text concludes that the ranks are fairly evenly distributed across the possible range and that there is no relationship between feedback-information quality and resulting binary performance.
text: Resubstitution does not reliably identify the best bzip2 FDO binary, indicating that ORC did not consistently turn more accurate same-input feedback into faster binaries in this study.
